cleared.check: L-1044 Task 2 on Zora: replay of mined PoolManager transactions from parent-block storage, because no public endpoint serves traces for this window. Method: scripts/gdrive.py runs each transaction whole in the reference interpreter scripts/pyevm_tx24.py through scripts/lazyreplay24.py, reading every account, code, balance, nonce and storage word lazily from the parent block (eth_getCode, eth_getBalance, eth_getTransactionCount, eth_getStorageAt). It compares status, every receipt log in order, every PoolManager storage word read or written against eth_getStorageAt at the block when no later transaction of the block emits a PoolManager log, and the PoolManager native balance change when the transaction is the only one of the block with a PoolManager log. A transaction whose status, PoolManager logs, PoolManager words or native balance differ is run again after every earlier transaction of its block on the same state (up to 120 earlier transactions). Gas is not modelled, so ERC-4337 EntryPoint events that report gas cost differ by design.

leadResults.answer: The word by word replay was extended to all eleven networks. Traced replay from prestate (cycle 23 model): OP Mainnet 18526, Ink 20000, Tempo 20000, X Layer 5784, Robinhood Chain 7879, Elysium 7858, Celo 1 transactions, 2981022 words, no mismatch. Parent-block storage replay where no public endpoint serves traces for the window: Zora 2000 (newest 2,000 of a whole history of 15,873), World Chain 1287, Soneium 1466, Arc 2000, Celo 773. No PoolManager log, status, PoolManager storage word or PoolManager native balance change differs from the reference in any transaction that the reference could run to the end on the same block state; the parent-storage residue is ERC-4337 EntryPoint gas figures (gas is not modelled), logs of other contracts whose state earlier transactions of the block changed, BLOCKHASH and the 0x07 precompile (not modelled), and one World Chain transaction whose searcher contract never reached the PoolManager in the reference. The targets of 20,000 per network were not reached on OP Mainnet, X Layer, Robinhood Chain and Elysium because the only public trace endpoints for the older part of the window rate limit or have pruned history, and the parent-storage samples are 2,000 or fewer because one replay takes seconds of CPU; these limits are stated per network in the cleared entries.

BNB Smart Chain reached 14274 traced transactions (blocks 135819656 to 135832906), up from 1,706, with no mismatch in 312782 words. https://bsc.api.pocket.network rotates Geth v1.7.8, Geth v1.8.2 and reth-bsc v0.1.4-hotfix-23b510f; the Geth backends refuse older blocks with "required historical state unavailable (reexec=128)", the reth-bsc backend answers archive traces, so each trace was retried until it was answered and every record carries web3_clientVersion read just before and just after its trace calls. bsc-rpc.publicnode.com (reth-bsc) has no debug methods and keeps about 10,000 blocks of state without a token; bsc-dataseed1 (Geth v1.8.2) keeps about 128 blocks. 20,000 was not reached in the session because of the retries; the collector can continue from raw/56/window.json.
